label: Recombined milk
comment: The fat comes from anhydrous milk fat; the single drawn parent is the powder.
note: Used where there is little or no milk: the powder and the butter oil travel and keep for months, the milk is made at the dairy and then pasteurised or UHT-treated.

about.text: Milk made again from its dried parts: skimmed milk powder dissolved in water and anhydrous milk fat emulsified into it. Dairies in countries with little milk of their own make it, then pasteurise or UHT it like fresh milk.

links.name: Tetra Pak Dairy Processing Handbook: Recombined milk products

facts.v: Soft: under about 5.5 °dH, low in copper (0.05 mg/l) and iron
